latest.title: Traumatic pneumothorax: most EDs don't drain early
latest.finding: 231 patients (68.1%) were initially managed without drainage; pneumothorax size >35 mm (aOR 41.0, 95% CI 16.4–102) and haemothorax (aOR 6.3, 95% CI 2.5–15.8) predicted ED-initiated drainage; 22.8% of drained patients had a recorded complication and in-hospital mortality was 5.6%.
